item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00386","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C05","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. Both are presidential letters establishing a committee, designating the recipient as chairman, enumerating senior federal members, anticipating participation or cooperation beyond the core federal membership, stating hoped-for committee results involving federal-state coordination, and addressing continuing support or reporting. The especially close sequence and wording—establishing the committee, “I am designating you as Chairman,” followed by “In addition”—go beyond generic committee boilerplate. C05 and C08 are also strong committee-establishment templates with nearly the same appointment sequence, but they lack C14’s emphasis on cooperative relationships between federal and state agencies.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"It is now my pleasure to name you as Chairman of the federal membership of the joint action committee. In addition to yourself, I am asking the Secretary of Labor, the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare, the Director of the Bureau of the Budget ... to serve on the Committee.","parent_excerpt":"I am establishing an Interdepartmental Committee on Migratory Labor made up of the Secretaries of the Interior, Agriculture, Labor, and Health, Education, and Welfare and the Administrator of the Housing and Home Finance Agency. I am designating you as Chairman. In addition, there are other departments and agencies which have major interests in specific areas...","explanation":"The letters share a concrete operative sequence: establish or identify the committee, appoint the recipient as chairman, list cabinet-level members, and then provide for additional participation."},{"child_excerpt":"I sincerely hope that the efforts of the Committee will result in less centralized and thereby more responsive and efficient government for the American people.","parent_excerpt":"It is my hope that this Committee will aid the various Federal agencies in mobilizing and stimulating more effective programs and services for migrants and in providing service to State and local areas through their constituent members. I believe this Committee can be of great help in developing cooperative relationships between the Federal agencies and the State agencies concerned with these problems.","explanation":"Both close the operative appointment with a statement of hoped-for results centered on more effective federal action and federal-state cooperation."},{"child_excerpt":"Steps are being taken to provide for the necessary staff assistance on the Joint Committee.","parent_excerpt":"I shall look forward to having periodic reports from you concerning the progress and recommendations of the Committee.","explanation":"Each includes a short administrative follow-through provision after establishing leadership and membership, reinforcing the shared committee-creation letter structure."}]}
